description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3040012518895 HOUSING,MECHANICAL: Line 0001 Qty 18 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0074 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
